decisions.source_basis: Direct full-page inspection clearly reads Police Retail/Restaurant: $1,004, -2.09%, $983, for 1,000 Sq. Ft of Building. The candidate and frozen source grid match. Conflicting captions are not alternative source readings; no candidate amount edit is justified.
No -A is visible on the complete page. The native extraction retains that non-visible artifact separately. It is not an intentional packaging marker and is not inserted into visible text.

The EAF grid has indicators across columns, Weight and % change as rows, a blank final weight cell, and -2.07% in the final percent cell. Native order scrambles label association. It is unsafe to call that harmless unless the explicit grid is retained. No weights, percentage calculations or rounding were recomputed here.
Round bullets are visible. Native U+F0B7 is an extraction encoding, not visual proof of another Unicode character. Preserve native bytes and describe the glyph separately.

The table uses a Fee Structure heading spanning description and Unit columns; 2025 Fee, % Change and 2026 Fee are multi-line headings. Their explicit associations must be carried into the source grid. Flattened order alone is not sufficient.

Industrial is the final Transportation row: $3,273, -2.08%, $3,205, with 1,000 Square Feet of Building. Native order emits the first six labels and numeric columns separately. Preserve the reviewed row mapping rather than calling raw order harmless.
The expressly labeled page fences are deliberate packaging. Whitespace loss is documented separately where it affects associations; these markers are not source errors.

Page 3 shows Transportation Development Fee and Unit but no repeated year/change headings. The baseline grid explicitly carries the heading reference from page 2. No missing headings are invented as page-3 source text.

Residential descriptions visibly span the first two columns: the internal divider does not run through those rows. They are merged description/unit areas, not separately printed blank unit cells. No unprinted unit such as per dwelling is inferred.
Page 2 prints 1,000 Sq. Ft of Building, with a period after Sq and no visible period after Ft. Page 3 prints 1,000 Square Feet of Building. Preserve both source forms.
The complete third paragraph reads: The fee changes by type of Development Impact Fee are presented on the attached schedule. The alternate cut-off caption is unsupported.

The full page shows year end without a hyphen and dash-like separators in the bullets and EAF caption. Exact native codepoints are preserved; their Unicode identity cannot be certified from pixels alone.

November 1, 2025 is the printed memo date; 2026 is the fee-year title; March 1, 2026 is asserted as an effective date. The cited code and adoption instruments are not verified here. The separate Water and Sewer adoption in December remains prospective in this source, without an explicit December year or water/sewer rates.

The report coverage table claims the same running title on pages 2 and 3. Direct full-page views show the running title only on page 1. Page 2 starts with For 2026; page 3 starts with Transportation Development Fee. No running title is added to the latter pages. All three pages have no printed page numeral.

decisions.source_basis: The logo visibly includes City of, Greeley and Colorado. Its text is absent from the native candidate. Source pixels preserve it; no exact artwork or color certification.

The full footer visibly reads Water and Sewer Department; 1100 10th Street, Suite 300, Greeley, CO 80631; (970) 350-9811 Fax (970) 350-9805, with round separators. The candidate omits this line. Exact separator Unicode is not inferred.
A City Achieving Community Excellence is visibly printed below the footer rule and absent from the candidate.

There are two distinct side-by-side tables, seven tap-size rows on the left and one Single Family row on the right. Native order interleaves the right-hand row with the left first row. Explicit table and cell identities preserve the association; raw sequential reading alone should not be described as reliably harmless.
Water Tap Size is one visibly multi-line header cell. Native line breaks are faithful to wrapping; the geometry and leading spaces carry no additional unit semantics.
Blank lines and trailing whitespace are retained native formatting. No wording correction is justified by whitespace alone.

Table borders and bold type are visible. Bold is not confined to the first data row: the later tap-size data rows also visibly use bold figures. Plain text omits that styling, but amounts and table associations are preserved separately.

The page-1 footer has a thin rule; page 2 has two separately bordered tables with a gap between their top borders. No extra header underline is inferred. The original page images preserve all observed rules and artwork.
Physical-page fences are deliberate candidate packaging, not source-transcription errors.

Directly checked all seven tap-size rows and the separate Single Family row. The amounts match the candidate and frozen source grid, including 466,500 and 284,800 on the 6-inch row. No fee computation or inferred eligibility rule added.
Dollar signs are printed on both amounts in the first tap-size row and both Single Family amounts, with none on later tap-size rows. Preserve this convention.
Body phone is (350-9801); footer phone is (970) 350-9811 and fax is (970) 350-9805. These are different printed numbers as well as different formatting. Do not normalize one to the other.
The two independently labeled 3/4-inch tap and Single Family rows both print $11,200 and $6,800. Equal numbers do not establish identical legal applicability.

Erik Dial, Utility Finance Manager, Greeley Water and Sewer is a printed signoff beneath Sincerely. No wet-ink signature is visible in the reviewed full page; this is a bounded image observation, not a document-authenticity conclusion.
The body visibly uses Water and Sewer Department with capital Water. The lowercase-water caption is unsupported by the directly inspected source.

The notice date, December 16, 2020 meeting and March 1, 2021 conditional effective language agree with the native candidate. Retain assuming they are adopted. The City of Greeley is the issuer; Weld County contractors are the addressed audience.
The proposed notice and attached printed schedule do not establish later adoption, applicability, amendment completeness or current fees. Legal currentness remains unverified.

The four errata rows do not alter frozen Pass1. E1/E2 are affirmations already addressed above. Direct pixels show serif letterforms on page 2; exact font family is not identified. Its two table top borders have a visible central gap; a separate underline below the document heading is not observed. Preserve external uncertainty as history while qualifying the source geometry.

Seven reported themes remain scoped: exact Unicode, fine artwork/colors and micro-spacing are not certified; table geometry is addressed above. The complete lower page 2 is visibly blank at this display scale, not a forensic faint-mark test. The original PDF is present and rehashed by Atlas, independently of its reported absence from the Grok workdir. Native bytes and all source images stay unchanged.
